featured.title: CUET Mars Rover — Autonomous Navigation System
featured.problem: Designing a fully autonomous Mars rover capable of GPS-denied terrain navigation for the University Rover Challenge 2027 — one of the most competitive collegiate robotics events globally.
built: Technical roadmap for autonomous navigation on the Jetson Orin Nano edge platform
Sensor fusion pipeline (camera + IMU + GPS fallback) for traversal planning
Cross-functional coordination across Mechanical, Electrical, Science, and Software teams (30+ members)
results: First CUET team to target URC — establishing institutional precedent
Tangible proof of ME + AI convergence
featured.alignment: Core project demonstrating autonomous systems capability — directly aligns with robotics and computer vision research interests.

featured.title: AURA AI Concierge — AI-Powered Service Discovery Platform
featured.problem: Service marketplaces lack intelligent matching — users can't describe problems in natural language and get instant diagnosis, pricing, and provider booking.
built: Full-stack AI platform using React + Tailwind CSS with conversational AI (Voiceflow)
Real-time automated diagnosis and fixed-price quoting from natural language input
Job dispatch system via Make.com webhooks with a Kanban-style provider dashboard
Multi-step identity verification pipeline (NID upload) for trust and safety
Provider dashboard with real-time notifications, job history, availability toggle
results: End-to-end autonomous user journey from problem → diagnosis → booking
Top 100 out of 538 teams (SOLVIO AI Hackathon)
featured.alignment: Shows product engineering and AI integration ability — proving capacity to ship complex, real-world systems.

featured.title: AI-FICATION — Automatic Speech Recognition System
featured.problem: Building a high-accuracy ASR (Automatic Speech Recognition) system under hackathon constraints — a signal processing + deep learning challenge.
built: End-to-end ASR pipeline for speech-to-text conversion
Audio preprocessing and feature extraction pipeline
Deep learning model training and optimization
results: Best University Team recognition from CUET
Demonstrates core ML competency in a non-trivial domain
featured.alignment: Pure ML project with strong competition results — validates deep learning implementation skills.
